recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed unless the schema generator regresses to using display/title text for XML type names.
issue_request: FHIR-26896 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction, raised against R4 and applied for R5, reporting that the R5 schema generated a type named Event Or Request Resource Types-list.
initial_application: No commit explicitly tagged with FHIR-26896 was found. The source-side defect was corrected implicitly in cbac492e57, which changed valueset-event-or-request-resource-types from a ValueSet.name with spaces to EventOrRequestResourceTypes and moved the human-readable phrase to title.
additional_context: FHIR-27816 and FHIR-28226 later reported the same invalid generated type name, and FHIR-32108 is an existing combined-branch audit for related fhir-single schema corrections.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The active source now uses EventOrRequestResourceTypes as the ValueSet.name, and current R5/current-build schema checks do not emit Event Or Request Resource Types as an xs type or QName.
